# <span id="aanchor10"></span> Export a Report

<div class="procedure">

To export a report:

1.  Select one or more reports and the data to display.

2.  Click the **Export** button.

3.  Specify a directory where the reports will be saved.

    Remember that this is the path relative to the computer FLOWCAL has been executed from. If you want a report written to the D:\\ drive on your local computer, browse to the D:\\ drive on your computer; otherwise, the Reports service will write the file to its own D:\\ drive. For report schedules, this path will be relative to the computer where the Reports service is running.

4.  Select the file format to export the report to, such as PDF. (See: [Crystal Export Types](Crystal%20Export%20Types.md) )

5.  If applicable, select options for the output file name. You can define text to append or prepend to the file name, or use one of the following variables:

    - **%RUNDATE%** - The time stamp for the export using a MM-DD-YY HH-MM-SS (24-hour) format

    > <div class="example">
    >
    > **For example:** If the run date is August 2, 2017, at 3:07:08 pm, the variable will translate to "08-02-17 15-07-08".
    >
    > </div>

    - **%SCHEDNAME%** - The name of the schedule
    - **%RPTMONTH%** - The name of the reporting month

6.  Select an output file configuration option. By default, FLOWCAL creates one file for meter reports.
    - **Output Common File** (default) – Export one file for the selected meter(s)
    - **Output Individual File per Meter** – Export a separate file for each meter
    - **Output Individual File into Meter Directory** – Export a separate file and directory for each meter

7.  Click **OK**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 539;height: 311;" />

</div>
